My dear [Christabel](../persons.html#329),
I should have said that I think you must specify your stones, there are such a frightful number- Pray have opal and turquoise- One for its weird history, the other for its nature- but exclude all the stupid ones, like garnets &c or we shall be swamped - I shall send the parcel on Monday - Meantime I send you the grand Goslings acceptance[^2] - I think [Fernseed](../persons.html#1160) must be her name - [Ladyfern](../persons.html#455) & [Magpie](../persons.html#896) keep on after all.

This Fernseed is to be directed to as
Miss Peard
Sparnow
Torquay
your affectionate
Mother Goose

[^1]: Endorsed ‘January 12 1866’.

[^2]: Frances Peard’s answer to CMY’s request that she join the [Gosling Society](../others.html#104).
